bio: Matteo Busato, once a humble facchino (porter) born to a family of laborers from Murano, has risen to remarkable prosperity through shrewd trade and tireless effort. Despite his humble origins lacking formal education, Matteo has developed an uncanny ability to identify profitable trading opportunities and calculate risks with precision.
